architecture.answer: The PDP-11/70 uses 16-bit virtual addresses (64 KiB per space), which the memory-management unit translates into 22-bit physical addresses spanning 4 MiB. Separate instruction and data spaces do not increase the virtual address width beyond 16 bits [ref:1170-addresses].
